pairs.subject: settings
pairs.evidence: app/_lib/db/analytics.ts:1124 The analytics goal and ROI-baseline keys the dashboard writes inline (recruiter hourly CZK, manual hours per hire) are upserted in place with only updated_at, and no old value, origin or actor is kept anywhere. Every hours-saved and CZK figure on the tab can therefore drift with no record of which baseline moved, when, or who moved it.

techniques.evidence: app/_lib/db/analytics.ts:1124 Writes overwrite the row in place: no old/new record, no category or origin. The target POST route (app/api/analytics/targets/route.ts) writes no audit row either, and grep found no audit trail for analytics_targets.

app/features/insights/analytics/AnalyticsTypes.ts:117 Callers use named constants re-exported from one registry (analytics-target-keys.ts), and the save route validates writes against the same registry, so both ends of the pipe are covered.

app/features/insights/analytics/AnalyticsTab.tsx:96 Targets ride in the single /api/analytics payload rather than per-key reads. After a save the panel reloads, and the route invalidates the server read memo (invalidateAnalyticsWorkspace), so a user reads back their own write.

app/features/insights/analytics/analyticsSaveFailure.ts:33 A failed inline write resolves to a localized, code-specific failure the input renders, so a 403 policy refusal and a 500 save failure are told apart instead of failing silently.

pairs.subject: settings
pairs.evidence: app/_components/LanguageSwitcher.tsx:24 The locale defaults to a live source (no cookie means Accept-Language, per getServerLocale), but the switcher writes the cookie for any newly picked locale. A user who switched away and then switches back to the locale their browser resolves to gets pinned to it, and no surface in the shell offers the 'auto' re-attach that setLocale already supports.

techniques.evidence: app/_components/LanguageSwitcher.tsx:24 Unconditional write: when the target equals the Accept-Language resolution the cookie is set rather than deleted, which is the 'correct on first press, corrupt on second' failure. The guard at line 22 only skips re-picking the already-active locale.
app/_components/BrandStyle.tsx:12 The brand config is read once on the server per request and handed to every client consumer through context, with no per-component fetch and no flash.

app/_components/BrandStyle.tsx:24 The accent is validated at the write door (sanitizeAccentColor) and consumers get a typed BrandConfig. The provider default is a stated decision (BrandProvider.tsx:17, empty, never invent a company).
